med-emr-qc-pe-hpi-inconsistent 1.0.0

- Initial release of the outpatient medical record QC skill focusing on "inconsistency between physical examination results and history of present illness" (PE-HPI inconsistency).
- Supports structured plain text medical records with common Chinese field labels, as well as multiple input formats (pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, csv, txt, json) via scripts.
- Invokes HiVoice MaaS medical LLM in OpenAI-compatible fashion to determine "no defect" or "defect" plus explanation.
- Implements strict data privacy: no identifying info processed, requires desensitized input, and does not persist any input or intermediate results.
- Designed as an auxiliary QC tool (not diagnostic or therapeutic); final judgment reserved for physicians.
- Pure Python 3.7+, no third-party dependencies except for multi-format file support.
